# pineconebyoc Provider

You can use this Terraform provider to register a Pinecone BYOC environment with [Pinecone](https://www.pinecone.io/). The rest of the environment comes from the cloud's own provider, such as `hashicorp/aws`.

Use it through the [BYOC module](https://github.com/pinecone-io/terraform-pinecone-byoc), which calls these resources in order. To install an environment, see the module's [install steps](https://github.com/pinecone-io/terraform-pinecone-byoc#install).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pineconebyoc = {
      source  = "pinecone-io/pineconebyoc"
      version = "~> 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

# Reads the API key from PINECONE_API_KEY.
provider "pineconebyoc" {}
```

## Authentication

The provider needs the [API key](https://docs.pinecone.io/admin/projects/manage-api-keys) of the Pinecone project that registers the environment. It reads it from `PINECONE_API_KEY`, or from `api_key` set to an ephemeral value. Don't pass the key as a plain variable: it would be stored in saved plans.

Ephemeral values need Terraform 1.10 or later, or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. For example, from AWS Secrets Manager:

```terraform
ephemeral "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "pinecone" {
  secret_id = "pinecone/byoc/api-key"
}

provider "pineconebyoc" {
  api_key = ephemeral.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.pinecone.secret_string
}
```

`api_url` and `auth0_domain` default to Pinecone's endpoints. Leave them unset.

## Resources

- `pineconebyoc_environment` registers the environment and mints its credentials. Create it first.
- `pineconebyoc_dns_delegation` delegates the environment's subdomain of `pinecone.io`. Only for environments on Pinecone's domain.
- `pineconebyoc_dns_delegation_validation` waits until the parent zone serves that delegation. Request certificates through it.
- `pineconebyoc_amp_access` lets the environment's Prometheus write to Pinecone's AMP.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key of the Pinecone project that registers the environment. Defaults to `PINECONE_API_KEY`. Set it only from an ephemeral value, so it never reaches a saved plan.
- `api_url` (String) Pinecone API URL, over https. Defaults to https://api.pinecone.io.
- `auth0_domain` (String) Auth0 domain that issues service account tokens, over https. Defaults to https://login.pinecone.io.
